title: State Ownership: Local → Composable → Pinia → Server → Persistent
objectives: Choose the narrowest state home that works
Know what belongs in persistent storage

examples.name: ladder.ts

exercise.prompt: Pick the narrowest correct home: "dropdown open?" (local), "auth user" (Pinia), "products list from API" (server-state cache), "theme preference" (persistent), "form field value" (local).
hints: Do not put everything in global state — UI toggles die with the component.
Server data is a cache of remote truth; theme survives restarts.

questions.prompt: Putting every component flag into Pinia leads to…
options: a global-state dumping ground where nothing can change safely
questions.explanation: Global state is the widest possible scope; widen scope only when sharing is real. (Vuex mutations, incidentally, are history — Pinia removed them.)

questions.prompt: Server data differs from client state because…
options: its source of truth is remote and must be cached/invalidated
questions.explanation: Server state needs cache semantics (staleness, refetch, invalidation), not just storage.
